propositions: The divergent_implementation axis fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings despite existing to classify omitted-scope sites; of 1,307 findings in the omitted-scope family, 90% are graded none, causing impact=0.0 and blocking not to trigger on valid divergences.

A G6 finding (fc347224733dccc6b) asserting false scope exclusions scored impact=0.0 despite validity=0.8889 and block_threshold=0.60 because the axis was never calibrated beyond one line of prose and never mapped to any scoring mechanism.

Replacing the ordinal none/low/medium/high grades with a closed Literal (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration, none) and mirroring the oracle-kind precedent requires excluding divergent_implementation from the generic _SEV01 contribution loop and introducing _PLAN_GRADED_AXES to keep the contribution and override loops in sync.

A production-impact floor (Fix 2) collides with the novelty_priority_floor=0.4 convergence mechanism by lifting unbounded severity bands orthogonal to whether findings are novel, whereas divergence grading is semantically bounded and remediable by author edit.

ADR-0054 rejects purpose-built LLM eval suites and bulk re-review as calibration instruments, narrowing ADR-0036 to two zero-marginal-cost forms: offline replay of the existing REVIEW_RESULT corpus and dogfooding in normal use with field observation.

The worst-case corpus replay (all non-none grades → floor grades) bounds the change to +81 new blocks across 1,396 findings (~5.8%), well below the 113-finding over-fire that an ungraded blunt widening would have produced.
